entities.name: José María Libório Camino Saracho
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José María Libório Camino Saracho was a Spanish-Brazilian Roman Catholic prelate. He served as the auxiliary bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of São Miguel Paulista from 1999 to 2002, titular bishop of Urusi from 1999 to 2002, and the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Presidente Prudente from 2002 until his retirement in April 2008.
